home.metaTitle: Appointments, front desk and patient records for clinics
home.metaDescription: raclinic is a bilingual cloud workspace for clinics and medical centers in Egypt and Saudi Arabia: patient registry, doctors' schedules, conflict-free booking, check-in and the daily queue.
home.title: Your clinic, organized from the first booking to the last visit
home.lead: raclinic is a cloud workspace for clinics and medical centers in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Register patients, set each doctor's working hours, book without clashes, and follow arrivals and the waiting queue — in Arabic or English, for one clinic or several branches.

booking.title: No double bookings
booking.body: Free times come from the doctor's working hours and existing bookings, and are checked again the moment a booking is confirmed.

queue.title: An orderly waiting room
queue.body: Reception checks patients in as they arrive; doctors see who is waiting in order of arrival, then start and finish each visit.

records.title: One record per patient
records.body: Contact details are entered once and shared by the branches where the patient is registered, instead of scattered notebooks and spreadsheets.

branches.title: Several branches, clear access
branches.body: Each team member sees only the branches and actions their role allows; doctors see their own appointments.

home.pathsLead: Start from the solution closest to your clinic; all of them run on the same operational workspace today.
home.availableLead: These features work now in the shared workspace:
home.plannedBody: Clinical records, specialty tools such as dental charts, physiotherapy treatment plans and ENT examination records, billing, reminders and online booking for patients are planned for later stages. They are not part of the workspace today.

price.a: Prices and subscription plans have not been announced yet. They will be published before raclinic is offered commercially.

clinical.q: Can I keep clinical notes and medical records?
clinical.a: Not yet. The current workspace covers administration: patient contact details, schedules, appointments and the daily queue. Clinical records are planned for a later stage.

specialties.q: Are there tools specific to dentistry, physiotherapy or ENT?
specialties.a: Not yet. These specialties use the shared operational workspace today. Specialty tools will be designed with practising clinicians and added later.

ai.q: Does raclinic include AI or diagnosis?
ai.a: No. Our line “Smart clinic management” is about organizing the clinic's daily work. raclinic does not diagnose, recommend treatments or write medical notes automatically.

branches.q: Does it suit a center with several specialties or branches?
branches.a: Yes. You can enable several specialties, choose which branches offer each one, and give every team member access to their own branches only.

ownership.q: Can I have a system of my own instead of a subscription?
ownership.a: You can request a custom project. Its scope, schedule, support and price are agreed separately for each project after a review of your needs.

data.q: Can I enter real patient data now?
data.a: No. This is a development version: please use test data only.

languages.a: Arabic and English, with right-to-left and left-to-right layouts. Each user chooses their language.
